sets.description: Description: BOH Corridor Exit (CR DE PH)
sets.notes: Notes: Operational Narrative: 1. Door normally closed and secure. 2. Authorized access by card reader shunting DE lock for predetermined time limit. 3. Egress free for immediate exit, however delayed egress will activate, local alarm will sound and door will release after 15 seconds. 4. Delayed egress when activated must be reset with local key switch installed at accessible height. 5. Door position switch monitor open/closed status. 6. Delayed egress releases (fail-safe) in event of fire alarm or power loss. DE Mag includes keyed local cylinder override to shunt or reset delayed egress.

Egress free for immediate exit, however delayed egress will activate, local alarm will sound and door will release after 15 seconds. 4. ADO access by actuator switch either side. Actuator energized only upon valid card reader presentation. 5. Delayed egress when activated must be reset with local key switch installed at accessible height. 6. Door position switch monitor open/closed status. 7. Delayed egress releases (fail-safe) in event of fire alarm or power loss. DE Mag includes keyed local cylinder override to shunt or reset delayed egress.
